name: Turkey Larb Lettuce Wraps
description: Thai-style ground turkey and mushrooms with lime, fish sauce, ginger, and cilantro, in lettuce cups with jasmine rice on the side.

recipeInstructions.text: Start jasmine rice in a rice cooker or pot.
Whisk together fish sauce, the juice of limes, honey, and red pepper flakes.
Heat neutral oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring now and then, until their liquid cooks off and they brown, 6-8 minutes.
Add ground turkey and cook, breaking it into small crumbles, until no longer pink, 5-6 minutes.
Add shallots, ginger, and garlic. Cook until the shallots soften, 2 minutes. Take the pan off the heat.
Pour in the dressing and toss. Let it cool a couple of minutes, then fold in cilantro and scallions. Taste: it should be sour, salty, and a little spicy. Add more lime or fish sauce to get there.
Spoon into leaves of butter lettuce and serve with the rice.
For leftovers, store the filling apart from the lettuce. It's good cold or warm over rice for lunch. Keeps 3 days.
